props.description: The command in the top bar, which the copy button copies, such as `stackra create my-app`.
props.name: command

props.description: The mono label in the top bar, and the region's spoken name. Defaults to "Try it".
props.name: label

props.description: The recorded session, played a whole line at a time.
props.name: lines

props.description: What the session ends on, such as a framed localhost preview; shown once every line is.
props.name: result

props.description: When the session plays: once it scrolls into view (the default), at once, or `never` (the last frame only).
props.name: autoplay

props.description: The time between lines in milliseconds, by default the theme's `floor` motion step.
props.name: stepMs

props.description: Shows the copy button. Defaults to true.
props.name: isCopyable

props.description: The copy button's spoken name. Defaults to "Copy command".
props.name: copyLabel
